_about: Platform-agnostic tool definitions (JSON Schema, function-calling format). The same backend endpoints serve ElevenLabs and Vapi. BACKEND_URL and TOOL_SECRET are set up in step 3. Fields marked 'platform-injected' are filled by the platform (e.g. ElevenLabs dynamic variable {{system__conversation_id}}), not by the LLM.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Get free appointment times for a service on a given date at Smile Dental Yerevan. Always call this before offering any time to the patient. If the date is full or the clinic is closed, the result includes alternative dates.

service_id.description: Service code from the knowledge base.

date.description: Requested date in YYYY-MM-DD format, Yerevan time (UTC+4).

time_preference.description: Optional part of day the patient prefers.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Create a confirmed appointment. Call ONLY after the patient has explicitly confirmed service, date, time, name and phone number. Returns a booking number, or an error if the slot was just taken.

phone.description: Patient's phone number in international format, e.g. +37491234567.

time.description: Start time HH:MM (24h), must be one of the times returned by check_availability.

notes.description: Optional short note, e.g. 'new patient', 'tooth pain lower left', 'child age 7'.

conversation_id.description: platform-injected: {{system__conversation_id}} — links the booking to the call log.

example_error.message: This time was just booked. Call check_availability again.

tools.name: transfer_to_human
tools.description: Hand the conversation over to a human administrator. In the web demo this creates a callback request on the dashboard; on the phone (Vapi demo) it can also forward the live call. Use when the patient asks for a person, is angry, has a question outside the knowledge base, has an emergency, wants to cancel/reschedule, or a tool failed.

summary.description: One or two sentences for the administrator: what the patient wants and any details collected.

phone.description: Confirmed callback number in international format.

example_response.message: Administrator will call back within 15 minutes during opening hours.
